caption_hook: 🌋 Hawaii's Kilauea volcano has shot 54 lava fountains since late 2024, some 457 m high, and scientists now know why + 3 more wins 👇
question: Volcano, Neanderthals or solar: which story wins today? 👇
share_line: Send this to your favourite science nerd
first_comment: Bonus: in nearly 200 years of records, Kilauea had only shown clusters of repeated fountains 3 times before. Would you go see one? 🌋

stories.headline: Kilauea has shot 54 lava fountains, and now we know why
stories.summary: Since December 2024, Hawaii's Kilauea has fired 54 separate lava fountains, more often than ever recorded. USGS scientists found trapped gas pushes the magma up and down like a piston.
stories.why: Knowing what drives the fountains helps experts read the volcano's next move.

stories.stat_label: wooden pieces found at one site
stories.headline: Neanderthals were skilled woodworkers, rare finds show
stories.summary: Near Barcelona, researchers documented 597 wooden pieces up to 62,000 years old, kept as moulds in mineral crust. 13 were shaped by Neanderthals, including spears and a club.
stories.why: Wood almost never survives, so this fills a big gap in our ancestors' story.

stories.stat_label: cancer drugs set for a margin cap
stories.headline: India plans to cut what patients pay for 110 cancer drugs
stories.summary: The government will cap trade margins at 30% on 110 costly cancer drugs. Officials say some prices could fall by up to 70%, after finding average markups of about 170%.
stories.why: Long cancer treatment could become far less ruinous for families.

stories.headline: Solar has saved Europe €37.4 billion in gas imports
stories.summary: SolarPower Europe says sunshine cut gas demand enough to save €37.4 billion since gas prices spiked this year. In June, solar became the EU's largest power source, at 25%.
stories.why: Homegrown sunshine is shielding families from wild gas prices.

fun_fact: Kilauea has been erupting almost continuously for nearly 200 years.
